riscv64v/qemu._why: riscv.rvv.sinc lifts every vector instruction to a user operation; docs/difffuzz.md (RISC-V vector) lists these four open classes: vset{i}vl{i} do not write vl/vtype, register groups written past vd, the old vd read under an undisturbed policy or vl = 0, and FP/fixed-point ops not writing fflags/vxsat.
